characters.name: Antoine
characters.clueEn: He was the only man in the Dining Room.
characters.clueZh:
他是餐厅里
唯一的男人。

characters.name: Denis
characters.clueEn: He was beside a shelf. He was not in the Kitchen.
characters.clueZh:
他在架子旁边。
他不在厨房。

characters.name: Fabrice
characters.clueEn: He was in the Kitchen, beside a table.
characters.clueZh:
他在厨房，
在桌子旁边。

characters.name: Henriette
characters.clueEn: She was the only person sitting in a chair.
characters.clueZh:
她是唯一一个
坐在椅子上的人。

characters.name: Vincent
characters.clueEn: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.
characters.clueZh:
受害者。他和凶手
单独在一起。
